data.description:
## Context / Problem

Private compatibility aliases remain for CLI help routing, `run_security_detectors`, graph/reducer symbols, split reducer processors, and grounding `DIMENSIONS`. Their consumers are internal source or test/monkeypatch paths; no public wire or persisted-data contract requires them. The governing ADR is delivered by earthen-wheat-chick.

## Approach

After the ADR merges, migrate all consumers to `_help_route`, `run_detectors`, graph loader/reducer canonical owners, split reducer processor modules, and `grounding.oracle.DIMENSIONS`. Delete old aliases only when both semantic references and raw dynamic/string/monkeypatch census are empty.

## Scope

- CLI help aliases
- code-review detector, graph/reducer, and grounding compatibility bindings
- every source/test/patch/dynamic consumer

## Testing

Run targeted CLI/help, security-detector, graph/reducer, and grounding suites plus semantic and raw reference censuses.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each listed old private name is absent after all consumers migrate to its named canonical owner.
- [ ] Tests patch or import only canonical owners.
- [ ] Public CLI behavior, security detector results, graph reduction, reducer events, and grounding dimensions remain unchanged.
- [ ] Focused suites and complete semantic/raw reference scans pass.
data.title: Migrate and remove CLI, security, graph, reducer, and grounding internal shims
